messages:
nina: Quick copy check — inline help for credential expiry in the Console (API keys / service creds). Need wording that explains when keys expire, what happens to running requests, and next steps. Must be calm + not alarmist.

chris (Security): Call out exact TTL if available, otherwise say 'will expire soon'. Avoid words like 'stop' alone; prefer 'requests will be rejected' for clarity.

ora (Product): Keep it short. Users should immediately see: expiry time, impact, and action (rotate or extend). CTA label should be descriptive like 'Rotate key' or 'Extend expiry'.

copybot: Accessibility: buttons should be verbs + object. Avoid vague tooltips like 'More'. Add aria-describedby for the expiry note. :robot_face:

nina: Drafts below. Short + longer version.

Draft A (compact):
```
API key expires in 3 days.
Requests using this key will be rejected after expiry. Rotate or extend the key to avoid interruptions.
[Rotate key] [Extend expiry]
```

chris: "Rejected after expiry" is good but maybe say "requests will start failing" — that's more conversational and less legalistic.

ora: Also we sometimes allow an overlap window where old key works for 5 minutes after rotation if customer opts in. Don't promise it here; link to docs.

nina: Draft B (docs link):
```
API key expires on Mar 8 at 14:00 UTC.
Requests using this key will start failing after expiry. Rotate or extend the key to prevent interruptions. See docs for rotation best practices.
[Rotate key] [Extend expiry]
```

copybot: Suggestion: change CTA 'Rotate key' -> 'Rotate API key' for screen readers. And make 'See docs' a text link not a button.

chris: Important: include the key ID in the tooltip so users know which key is impacted when multiple keys exist. Also add a tiny hint about who can rotate (org admin vs project maintainers).

nina: Draft C (final candidate):
```
API key (id: abcd-1234) expires in 3 days (Mar 8 at 14:00 UTC).
Requests using this key will start failing after expiry. Rotate the API key or extend its expiry to prevent interruptions. Only org admins and project owners can rotate keys.
[Rotate API key] [Extend expiry]

Inline link: Rotation docs
```

ora: I like C. Maybe soften "will start failing" -> "may fail"? But failures are deterministic. Keep stronger wording.

chris: Keep the stronger wording. Also add a machine-readable timestamp in the DOM for assistive tech.

nina: Accessibility checks: CTA labels updated to verbs+object, add aria-describedby for the expiry sentence, include key ID. We'll render rotation docs link as small text link under CTAs.

rahul (DevEx): Implementation note: if user clicks Rotate, show a confirmation that calls out whether sessions continue or bound to new key. Also fire analytics for rotate/extend clicks.

nina: Thanks all. Final copy we'll push to the component library:
```
API key (id: abcd-1234) expires in 3 days (Mar 8 at 14:00 UTC).
Requests using this key will start failing after expiry. Rotate the API key or extend its expiry to prevent interruptions. Only org admins and project owners can rotate keys.
[Rotate API key] [Extend expiry]

Rotation docs
```

ora: QA: I'll check in Figma and ensure the key ID isn't overly prominent visually (privacy). Keep it visible but muted.

chris: I'll confirm wording with legal/security one last time but this looks good.

nina: I'll push the change to the banner component and request an a11y pass. Closing thread unless anyone objects."
